IC1: Age between one year and 18 years
IC2: Sepsis [AND] due to MDR or minimally susceptible gram-negative bacteria
IC3: History of MDR gram-negative infection [OR] or sepsis due to organisms sensitive to colistin.
IC4: Culture result consistent with MDR gram negative for this febrile neutropenic episode.
IC5: Patient in sepsis and colistin [AND] was administered empirically to increase antibiotic coverage.
